system.description:
Where lesser vampires bend one mind at a time, a truly skilled elder throws the weight of Dominate over an entire crowd, controlling masses with a single glance.

Declare Mass Manipulation before attempting the Dominate challenge. Spend a Willpower Trait and make a standard Dominate test against the most resistant member of the group; if he cannot be Dominated, neither can the rest. On a success you extend the effect to those around him. The maximum number of additional targets equals half your permanent Willpower (round up) - so seven permanent Willpower controls four subjects beyond the first. You choose the subjects and need only make eye contact with the initial target.
system.duration: As per the Dominate power used
